Title: Senior Manager – Hospitality Digital Systems & Data
Hotel Manager - Hilton Salwa Beach Resort & Villas
Description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

A Hilton Hotel Manager is a hospitality leader, a brand ambassador, and a steward of Hilton’s legacy of delivering exceptional guest experiences. At the heart of every Hilton hotel is a commitment to warm, reliable, and hospitable service—and the Hotel Manager brings this to life through thoughtful leadership and operational excellence.

**About the Hilton Brand**

For nearly a century, Hilton Hotels & Resorts has been proudly welcoming the world’s travellers. With more than 584 hotels across six continents, Hilton Hotels & Resorts provides the foundation for exceptional travel experiences and values every guest who walks through its doors. The most recognised name in the industry, Hilton remains synonymous with the word ‘hotel’. From inaugural balls and Hollywood award galas to business events and days to remember, Hilton is where the world makes history, closes the deal, toasts special occasions, and gets away from it all. As the flagship brand of Hilton, Hilton Hotels & Resorts continues to set the standard for hospitality, providing new product innovations and services to meet guests’ evolving needs.

**About the Property**

One of the largest resorts in the Middle East, Hilton Salwa Beach Resort & Villas is an unparalleled destination offering world-class facilities and bespoke services for today’s luxury leisure travellers. Sprawling across 3.5 kms of prime coastline, the resort offers 361 rooms, including 84 beachfront villas, the largest water park in Qatar- Desert Falls Water and Adventure Park, more than 20 restaurants showcasing global flavours, a beach club, swimming pools, a marina, luxury spa and a health club.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

As a **Hotel Manager** at a Hilton property, you’re not just leading hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Lead with Hilton’s commitment to exceptional hospitality:** Oversee all hotel operations to deliver warm, reliable, and hospitable service – ensuring every guest experience is seamless, consistent, and reflective of the brand’s high standards
* **Drive performance and profitability:** Manage revenue, budgets, and cost controls to achieve financial targets while balancing operational efficiency with innovative guest experiences
* **Oversee property priorities:** Lead capital projects, refurbishments, and service initiatives to maintain operational excellence and brand alignment
* **Set and execute strategic direction:** Shape short- and long-term goals, making decisions in the best interests of the hotel, the Hilton brand, and Hilton’s long-term vision
* **Inspire and develop talent:** Provide visionary leadership to the executive team and all Team Members, embedding Hilton’s values and fostering a team of passionate and creative professionals
* **Strengthen communication and collaboration:** Hold regular briefings with the Heads of Department (HOD) team and maintain strong relationships with owners, auditors, and Hilton stakeholders to ensure alignment and accountability
* **Commit to continuous improvement:** Uphold and exceed Hilton service standards, respond to audits proactively, and drive innovation and operational integrity across the business

  

**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader, with a strong focus on owner relations, commercial performance, and operational excellence. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

* An Established Director of Operations or Hotel Manager with strong operational experience in Rooms and/or F&B.
* Having strong international brand experience in a luxury resort environment is preferred.
* Extensive multi-cultural experience, adept at working with diverse teams and customers.
* Strong ability to collaborate and foster networks and relationships, with owners, contractors, corporates, and Tour Operators – must be highly visible.
* Demonstrable experience in delivering innovative commercial opportunities with experience in increasing profitability especially within Resorts.
* Dynamic and proactive approach with solid experience as an agent of change
* Exceptional people leadership and retention of talent with the ability to bring a team together on a journey and instilling the Hilton culture and values.
* Exceptional stakeholder/owner relations experience with demonstrable influencing skills.
* Ability to show resilience, judgement and leadership.
* Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar resort style property.
* Proven experience in delivering results with an eye for details and quality
* Experience in GCC/Qatar will be an advantage
* Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent.
* Fluency in English and Arabic required (spoken and written)

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Title: The Berkeley Hotel Executive Housekeeper
Description:
**About Company:**

Looking for an inspired leader to head up our housekeeping department at the historic luxury Berkeley Hotel.

55 rooms. Previous hotel management housekeeping required. Must be able to work weekends. As this is a smaller hotel, the exec would be expected to have a board of their own near daily.

**Our Vision**

Our vision is to become the premier hotel development company with a concentration in Washington, committed to excellence through strategic development and continued innovation in the hospitality industry. Guided by our core values, we will exceed the expectations of our guests and members and enhance the value of our partners' investments.

**Our Mission**

Our mission is to provide the ultimate guest experience through exceptionally talented associates committed to providing true hospitality. We do this by providing support, training, and growth for our team members while being fiscally responsible to our owners and investors.

**About the Role:**

The Hotel Executive Housekeeper at Berkeley plays a pivotal role in ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction throughout the property. This leadership position is responsible for managing and supervising the housekeeping team to maintain impeccable guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces. The Executive Housekeeper will develop and implement cleaning procedures, schedules, and quality control measures to optimize operational efficiency and uphold brand standards. Additionally, this role involves coordinating with other hotel departments to support seamless guest experiences and address any housekeeping-related concerns promptly. Ultimately, the Executive Housekeeper contributes significantly to the hotel's reputation by fostering a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for all guests and staff.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 years of experience in housekeeping, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or management role.
* Strong knowledge of cleaning.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team effectively.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a branded hotel environment.
* Familiarity with budgeting and inventory management.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations and environmental sustainability practices.
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish, to communicate with a diverse workforce.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, train, and supervise the housekeeping team to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality cleaning services.
* Develop and maintain cleaning schedules, inventory controls, and quality assurance protocols to meet brand and safety standards.
* Inspect guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces regularly to ensure cleanliness and maintenance needs are addressed.
* Collaborate with the front desk, maintenance, and management teams to coordinate room availability and resolve guest requests or complaints.
* Manage housekeeping budgets, including labor costs, supplies, and equipment procurement, while optimizing resource utilization.
* Recruit, onboard, and evaluate housekeeping staff performance, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.

**Skills:**

The Executive Housekeeper utilizes leadership and interpersonal skills daily to manage and inspire the housekeeping team, ensuring high morale and productivity. Organizational skills are critical for creating efficient cleaning schedules, managing inventory, and maintaining compliance with safety standards. Communication skills enable effective collaboration with other hotel departments and clear resolution of guest concerns. Problem-solving skills are essential when addressing unexpected maintenance issues or staffing challenges to maintain seamless operations. Additionally, knowledge of hospitality software and budgeting tools supports accurate tracking of expenses and resource allocation, contributing to the hotel's operational success.

Title: Hotel Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**

The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

**About Raffles Doha**

Step into a world of refined elegance and timeless artistry at Raffles Doha, an iconic address nestled within the architectural landmark of Katara Towers in Lusail.

Raffles Doha is where luxury becomes deeply personal — a place defined by quiet sophistication, meaningful moments, and the art of thoughtful service. Rooted in a legacy of gracious hospitality, Raffles is renowned for creating experiences that are intimate, bespoke, and unforgettable.

Here, every detail is considered, every interaction intentional, and every guest journey uniquely curated. Our colleagues are artisans of hospitality, empowered to anticipate needs, craft memories, and deliver service with elegance, discretion, and genuine care.

Joining Raffles Doha means becoming part of a storied brand where excellence is not an aspiration, but a standard — and where hospitality is expressed as an art form.

**About the Application Process**

At Raffles Doha, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

 **Job Description**

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Raffles Doha as our new Hotel Manager.

The Hotel Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments, ensuring the delivery of exceptional luxury hospitality experiences in line with the standards and philosophy of Raffles Hotels & Resorts.

The role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, guest satisfaction, and colleague engagement while ensuring seamless coordination and alignment across all operational functions. Working closely with the Executive Committee and department heads, the Hotel Manager translates the hotel's strategic objectives into actionable business plans, strengthens operational efficiencies, and drives a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As a key member of the hotel's leadership team, the Hotel Manager acts as the Managing Director's principal operational partner, ensuring the effective execution of business strategies, safeguarding the hotel's reputation, and reinforcing Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury hospitality destination.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Managing Director to define and execute the hotel's strategic objectives and priorities
* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments
* Drive operational excellence, revenue growth, profitability, and continuous improvement
* Monitor hotel performance and implement initiatives to enhance business results
* Ensure seamless operations and consistent delivery of Raffles brand standards
* Champion personalised luxury hospitality and exceptional guest experiences in line with Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards
* Oversee guest satisfaction, feedback, and effective service recovery
* Lead and develop the Executive Committee and departmental leaders, fostering a high-performance culture
* Drive colleague engagement, talent development, and succession planning
* Oversee financial performance, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and resource optimisation
* Maximise commercial opportunities and profitability across operational departments
* Ensure compliance with brand standards, company policies, and local regulations
* Oversee quality assurance, health and safety, security, and risk management
* Drive Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards, audits, service evaluations, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Build strong relationships with ownership, corporate stakeholders, key clients, and external partners
* Collaborate with commercial and support functions to strengthen business performance and market positioning
* Promote innovation, technology, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and guest experience
* Safeguard the hotel's reputation and strengthen Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury destination

  
**Qualifications**

**What will you bring to this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 10 years of experience in luxury hotel operations, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership position
* Proven track record within internationally recognised luxury hotel brands
* Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality standards, including Forbes Travel Guide, and LQA requirements
* Strong Food & Beverage experience across multiple outlets, with proven expertise in managing high-volume banquet operations
* Demonstrated success in driving operational excellence, financial performance, and guest satisfaction
* Strong commercial acumen and experience in budgeting, forecasting, and cost management
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop multicultural teams and senior leaders
* Excellent strategic thinking, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
* Extensive knowledge of hotel operations, quality assurance, and service excellence
* Strong understanding of health, safety, security, and regulatory compliance
* Previous experience in the Middle East luxury hospitality market is preferred
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

  
**Additional Information**

Inspired by the legacy of St. Regis, we create unforgettable experiences through personalized service that anticipates the needs of every guest. We are seeking a passionate and people-focused **Human Resources Manager** who will play a key role in attracting, developing, and engaging talent while fostering a culture that reflects our values and elevates the associate experience.

**JOB SUMMARY**

As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

**Preferred Qualifications & Attributes**

* Proven Human Resources leadership experience within a luxury hospitality environment
* Strong working knowledge of Qatar Labour Law and local employment regulations
* Ability to act as a strategic business partner, influencing stakeholders and driving people-focused initiatives across the hotel

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**

* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.
* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.
* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.
* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**

* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.
* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.
* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

* Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.

* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**

Title: Senior Manager | Tax & Legal | Legal | Legal Management Consultancy | KSA
Description:

Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. * Serve with integrity
* Take care of each other
* Foster inclusion
* Collaborate for measurable impact

As a Manager/Senior Manager (level dependent on experience), you will independently lead engagements or major workstreams within large-scale programmes, reporting to engagement partners and directors. Title: Marketing Director for Skilled Nursing
Description:
We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Marketing Director to lead and strengthen marketing and business development efforts across our skilled nursing facilities. This individual will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that drive sustainable census growth, increase referral opportunities, strengthen community partnerships, and enhance the organization's reputation within the healthcare community.

The ideal candidate is a relationship-focused leader with a strong understanding of the skilled nursing industry, healthcare referral networks, and post-acute care operations. This role requires a balance of strategic planning, hands-on execution, team leadership, and measurable performance accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Marketing & Business Development**

* Develop and implement regional and facility-specific marketing strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives.
* Identify new business opportunities and establish strategies to increase Medicare, Managed Care, and overall skilled admissions.
* Evaluate market trends, competitor activity, referral patterns, and service-line opportunities to identify areas for growth.
* Develop targeted outreach plans to expand the organization's presence and strengthen its position within the healthcare market.
* Establish measurable marketing goals, performance benchmarks, and accountability standards.

**Community & Referral Relationship Development**

* Develop strategies to strengthen existing referral partnerships while identifying and cultivating new referral sources.
* Represent the organization at community events, healthcare networking functions, and industry-related meetings.
* Ensure consistent follow-through with referral partners and proactively address concerns or barriers affecting referral relationships.

**Census Growth & Admissions Performance**

* Partner with facility Administrator, to develop and execute census growth strategies.
* Monitor admissions, referral conversion rates, skilled census, payer mix, and referral source activity.
* Identify barriers to admissions and collaborate with facility leadership to develop solutions.
* Ensure timely referral follow-up and promote a responsive, customer-focused admissions process.
* Establish facility-specific growth plans with clear targets, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Monitor progress against census goals and implement corrective strategies when performance falls below expectations.

* Develop and maintain marketing dashboards and reporting tools to track outreach activity, referral sources, admissions, conversion rates, and census trends.
* Analyze performance data and provide regular updates to executive and regional leadership.
* Identify underperforming facilities or referral relationships and develop focused improvement plans.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and adjust strategies based on measurable results.
* Provide insight into market opportunities, competitive positioning, and regional growth potential.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of healthcare marketing, business development, or sales leadership experience.
* Skilled nursing, post-acute care, hospital, or senior healthcare experience are strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success developing referral relationships and driving measurable business growth.
* Previous experience leading, coaching, and holding marketing teams accountable for performance.
* Strong understanding of Medicare, Managed Care, skilled nursing admissions, and post-acute referral processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to analyze performance metrics, identify opportunities, and develop actionable strategies.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.
* Willingness to travel and participate in community outreach activities.

Title: Senior Manager, Procurement
Description:

We are wholly owned by the City of Toronto and operate in a non-profit manner. We are an essential part of the City of Toronto's fabric and social system.
  
  
Our over 2,000 employees work to achieve our vision of quality homes in vibrant communities where people are proud to live and work.

The Senior Manager, Procurement is accountable for following all process and policy guidelines throughout the sourcing process and collaborate closely with divisional heads to ensure business needs are being managed proactively and efficiently.

* Advanced public procurement training or experience with a focus on category management and strategic sourcing
* Minimum 7 years (10+ years preferred) strategic sourcing procurement in a large/complex environment preferably in the facilities maintenance and construction industry with majority of the experience

Title: Senior Manager, Strategic Property & Development Partnerships
Description:
Calix is seeking an established property ecosystem and strategic partnerships leader to develop and manage relationships with organizations that own, develop, operate, manage, build, renovate, and influence technology deployment within the Managed Business ecosystem.  
Reporting to the Area Vice President, Managed Services Ecosystem & Partner Programs, the Senior Manager, Strategic Property & Development Partnerships will own the Property & Development Ecosystem across four strategic customer segments: Multifamily / MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, and Venues.  
The successful candidate will bring substantial expertise and active executive and operational relationships within at least one target segment, demonstrated familiarity with adjacent segments, and the ability to identify the organizations that exert the greatest influence over property development, capital planning, operating standards, procurement, technology selection, deployment, and managed-service adoption. This is not a role in which the core market network and domain expertise will be developed after joining Calix.  
The role will identify, prioritize, recruit, and manage the property and development organizations most important to Calix's Managed Business strategy. The role will translate these relationships into market insight, Product Group requirements, segment priorities, and repeatable opportunities for MSP and related channel partners. The role will also collaborate with Marketing on segment positioning, market activation, executive engagement, and ecosystem programs.

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

**Property & Development Partner Strategy**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain a prioritized partner strategy for each target customer segment.
* Apply existing market knowledge and relationships to identify the organizations and decision-makers with the greatest strategic relevance to Calix.
* Evaluate prospective partners using criteria such as property or venue footprint, development and renovation pipeline, operating influence, technology authority, market access, channel fit, strategic alignment, and ability to scale.
* Recommend where Calix should invest, where Calix should monitor, and where Calix should not pursue a relationship.
* Build segment-level ecosystem maps, partner portfolios, engagement plans, and relationship roadmaps.
* Continuously assess ownership trends, acquisition and redevelopment activity, operator shifts, consolidation, capital plans, procurement practices, and emerging market participants.

**Strategic Partner Development & Management**
----------------------------------------------

* Use an established network to open and accelerate relationships with senior leaders, operating executives, development leaders, technology decision-makers, procurement stakeholders, and design-build participants at priority organizations.
* Recruit, develop, and manage selected organizations within the Property & Development Ecosystem across the four customer segments.
* Establish shared objectives, executive sponsorship, operating cadences, mutual commitments, and measurable success criteria with priority partners.
* Coordinate relationship activity across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Sales, Operations, Legal, and technical stakeholders.
* Develop opportunities for market development, solution validation, design influence, joint education, reference architectures, property pilots, executive engagement, and other mutually beneficial initiatives.
* Maintain an accurate view of partner strategy, organizational dynamics, development and operating priorities, decision processes, and relationship health.

**MSP Route-to-Market Activation**
----------------------------------

* Partner with the MSP ecosystem team, Sales, and Business Development to convert property and development relationships into qualified, scalable opportunities for MSPs and related channel partners.
* Define clear engagement models, account roles, ownership boundaries, mutual value, and handoff processes among Calix, property ecosystem partners, and service-delivery partners.
* Identify repeatable demand-generation and deployment patterns that can be operationalized through MSP specializations, enablement, solution plays, and partner programs.
* Ensure that ecosystem activity supports an indirect route to market rather than creating an uncoordinated direct-sales motion.

**Product Group Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Serve as the primary ecosystem advisor to the Product Group for property, development, ownership, operating, and design-build organizations across the target segments.
* Bring informed owner, developer, operator, management, construction, deployment, and lifecycle requirements into solution planning.
* Help Product Group teams understand segment-specific workflows, property or venue operating realities, procurement models, installation constraints, capital cycles, and lifecycle requirements.
* Connect Product Group leaders with the right business, operations, development, technology, and deployment stakeholders at priority organizations.
* Coordinate discovery sessions, advisory discussions, solution validation, pilot opportunities, and launch-readiness input as appropriate.
* Provide candid recommendations when proposed solutions, partnerships, or segment assumptions do not align with market realities.

**Marketing & Segment Strategy Collaboration**
----------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Marketing on segment strategy for MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, and Venues.
* Contribute ecosystem intelligence to segment positioning, value propositions, messaging, content, campaigns, events, and thought leadership.
* Identify opportunities for partner stories, executive forums, relevant conferences, webinars, advisory councils, and market education.
* Help Marketing distinguish the ownership structures, operating models, buying processes, development cycles, capital plans, and influence patterns unique to each segment.
* Provide ongoing insight regarding investment activity, development and renovation trends, customer priorities, competitive moves, and partner-enabled routes to market.
* Use associations, conferences, and executive forums as channels for relationship development and market activation; this role does not own Calix's broader industry-organization or standards-body partnerships.

**Target Ecosystem Expertise**
==============================

Candidates should bring deep expertise and active relationships in at least one target segment, demonstrated familiarity with a second, and the ability to apply a common property-development and operating framework across all four segments.

**Multifamily / MDU**
---------------------

* Multifamily, planned-community, and build-to-rent developers, owners, operators, and property management organizations.
* Construction companies, general contractors, installation partners, low-voltage contractors, and smart-home integrators.
* Organizations responsible for property technology standards, deployment decisions, resident experience, capital planning, and building operations.
* Knowledge of how ownership, development, acquisition, redevelopment, property management, and construction stakeholders influence connectivity and managed-service decisions.

**Hospitality**
---------------

* Hotel brands and flags, including organizations such as Marriott, Hilton, IHG, and comparable companies that set technology standards or mandates.
* Hotel owners, ownership groups, and REITs, including organizations comparable to Host Hotels and Summit.
* Hotel management companies and operators, including organizations such as Aimbridge, Highgate, and comparable companies that operate properties and engage service providers.
* Hospitality developers, design-build participants, guest internet providers, in-room technology integrators, and organizations that influence new builds, renovations, property-improvement plans, conversions, deployment, and operations.

**Student Housing**
-------------------

* Student housing owners, operators, developers, and management companies, including organizations such as American Campus Communities, Greystar, The Preiss Company, Scion Group, and comparable companies.
* University housing departments and campus technology stakeholders that act as direct clients, operating stakeholders, or standards authorities.
* Public-private partnership organizations involved in developing and operating student housing.
* Construction, integration, access-control, and connectivity stakeholders supporting new development, renovations, high-density student communities, and annual turnover cycles.

**Venues**
----------

* Venue owners such as municipalities, school districts, colleges, private owners and developers, fairgrounds, cultural organizations, and comparable entities.
* Venue operators, promoters, tenant organizations, leagues, and event producers, including organizations such as VenuWorks, OVG360, ASM Global, and comparable companies.
* Architects, general contractors, low-voltage contractors, AV integrators, life-safety specialists, and other design-build participants.
* Organizations responsible for new venue development, renovation, connected venue systems, guest and staff operations, event-day reliability, sponsorship activation, and revenue-generating experiences.

**Property Lifecycle Coverage**
-------------------------------

* Influence technology and managed-service decisions across new development, acquisition and redevelopment, renovation and property-improvement planning, construction, installation, commissioning, property opening, ongoing operations, capital planning, and technology refresh cycles.
* Recognize when decision authority shifts among owners, developers, operators, brands, institutions, contractors, technology stakeholders, and service providers across the lifecycle.

**Market Intelligence & Internal Leadership**
=============================================

* Maintain a current, evidence-based view of priority organizations, decision-makers, market structures, development and renovation pipelines, capital plans, and operating trends in each segment.
* Translate relationships and market knowledge into clear decisions, recommendations, risks, and next actions for Calix leaders.
* Represent Calix at relevant real estate, hospitality, student housing, venue, construction, property-technology, and managed-services forums where target stakeholders participate.
* Coordinate with the broader MSP ecosystem program so property relationships support MSP specialization and Managed Business objectives.
* Create partner dashboards, portfolio views, opportunity assessments, and executive updates that support disciplined relationship management.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Real Estate, Hospitality Management, Urban Development, Marketing, Technology, Telecommunications, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic partnerships, business development, ecosystem development, property partnerships, hospitality partnerships, venue partnerships, or a closely related function.
* Deep expertise and active relationships within at least one of the following ecosystems: Multifamily / MDU, Hospitality, Student Housing, or Venues; demonstrated familiarity with at least one additional segment is strongly preferred.
* An established network of executive, operating, development, technology, procurement, construction, and deployment relationships at relevant organizations serving one or more target segments.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and prioritize high-impact organizations rather than applying a broad, undifferentiated relationship-management approach.
* Proven success establishing strategic relationships, market-development initiatives, advisory programs, go-to-market collaborations, or ecosystem programs involving owners, developers, operators, management companies, builders, integrators, or adjacent organizations.
* Strong understanding of how ownership structures, property or venue operations, capital plans, development and renovation cycles, procurement practices, and technology standards influence buying decisions.
* Experience connecting end-market relationships to MSPs, managed network providers, systems integrators, VARs, or other indirect service-delivery partners.
* Experience working directly with Product Management or Product Group teams to shape requirements, validate solutions, or inform segment strategy.
* Experience collaborating with Marketing on vertical strategy, positioning, campaigns, events, executive engagement, or partner activation.
* Strong executive communication, relationship management, negotiation, judgment, and cross-functional influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct relationships with major developers, owners, operators, management companies, hotel brands, REITs, university housing organizations, venue operators, construction companies, architects, contractors, or integrators relevant to the four target segments.
* Expertise spanning more than one target segment, with the ability to recognize common buying patterns and segment-specific differences.
* Experience with managed Wi-Fi, broadband, networking, smart-building technology, PropTech, guest technology, campus technology, connected venues, or managed-services business models.
* Experience supporting solution validation, pilot programs, reference designs, strategic alliances, or market advisory initiatives.
* Credibility and active participation in relevant property, hospitality, student housing, venue, construction, technology, or managed-services communities and conferences.
* MBA or related advanced degree.

The position is a key point of integration within the CRE team and with the bank’s other internal support functions who help deliver real estate projects including technology, procurement, security, finance and risk. **Key Accountabilities for Office and Critical Environments Projects**

* Leads, manages and develops BMO’s internal team responsible for the oversight of all office and critical environments (CE) projects globally.
* Provide direction, coaching, prioritization and performance oversight to the BMO project team.
* Establishes consistent delivery standards, practices and performance expectations, and drives continuous improvement.
Fosters a culture aligned to BMO’s purpose, values and strategy, promotes inclusion, establishes clear expectations and holds the team accountable for results.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

Title: Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Manager
Description:

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

**About Adonis Partners**

At Adonis Partners, we exist to help our clients become more profitable — and their people more capable. We show up to do the real work, shoulder-to-shoulder with our clients, committed to creating lasting, measurable impact.

We are a fast-growing business excellence consultancy of 60 professionals across North America, serving over 30 clients annually.

We combine data-driven insights, deep industry experience, and lived leadership to cut through complexity and deliver results. Our team is built on a foundation of openness, humility, and relentless value creation. That’s how we’ve earned trust — and why clients call us back.

We partner most often with companies in:

* Food & Beverage Manufacturing
* Healthcare and Life Sciences
* Packaging
* Transportation, Logistics, and Supply Chain

Our clients are typically upper mid-market ($200M to $2B in revenue), including PE-backed companies undergoing operational transformation. Engagements range from 3–12 months, often involving immersive, on-site collaboration.

**Our Values (How We Work)**

* Genuine, Transparent & Fair – We tell the truth, even when it’s hard.
* Relentless in Creating Value – We own the outcome, no matter the obstacles.
* Always Getting Better – We seek feedback and grow through experience.
* Move Fast – We take action with urgency and accountability.
* Go the Extra Mile – We roll up our sleeves and do what it takes.

We live a service philosophy based on vulnerability, humility, and radical honesty. It’s not always comfortable, but it builds the kind of trust that lasts.

**Position Summary**

As the Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Specialist, you will own and deliver full-cycle recruitment for Adonis Partners across Canada and the United States. You will work closely with company leadership and practice leaders to understand current and upcoming client engagement needs, translate those needs into clear talent profiles, and identify high-calibre consultants and professionals who can deliver measurable results for our clients.

This role requires more than general recruiting experience. You will develop targeted talent pipelines across consulting, supply chain, procurement, operational excellence, Lean Six Sigma, and business transformation. You will recruit for both permanent and project-based needs, build relationships with experienced independent consultants, and help ensure Adonis Partners can respond quickly to client requirements while maintaining a high standard of candidate experience.

* Identify opportunities to improve store productivity, sales conversion and customer experience.

* Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving and ageing stock and implement appropriate actions to improve stock turnover and sell-through.

* Ensure clear communication of targets, responsibilities and operational expectations across all stores.

Title: Senior Health and Safety Manager
Description:
At Mace, our purpose is to redefine the boundaries of ambition. We believe in creating places that are responsible, bringing transformative impact to our people, communities, and societies across the globe. To learn more about our purpose, culture, and priorities, visit our strategy site.

Within our consult business we harness our unique combination of leading-edge practical expertise and project delivery consultancy to unlock the potential in every project.

**You'll Be Responsible For:**

* Provide visible executive leadership for health, safety, and wellbeing across the program and model Mace’s Safety First value.
* Set and maintain program health and safety strategy, policy, standards, governance, delegated authorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective control of critical risks including excavation, shafts, temporary works, lifting, work at height, confined spaces, mobile plant, electrical systems, fire, track access, and simultaneous operations.
* Lead health and safety input into design, constructability, logistics, procurement, construction sequencing, energization, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Chair executive safety governance and critical-risk reviews, ensuring decisions are evidence-based and actions are owned and closed.
* Exercise authority to stop or defer work where risk is unacceptable, controls are ineffective, or legal and project requirements are not met.
* Promote occupational health, mental health, fatigue management, exposure control, ergonomics, inclusion, and workforce wellbeing.
* Act as the client’s principal health and safety adviser and provide clear recommendations to the program executive and governance bodies.
* Develop and govern the program health and safety management system, assurance plan, critical-risk framework, audit regime, and reporting model.
* Ensure constructors, contractors, designers, and suppliers discharge their legal, contractual, and project health and safety obligations.
* Lead risk-based assurance across stations, shafts, underground works, compounds, rail systems, testing and commissioning, and operational interfaces.
* Own executive reporting on leading and lagging indicators, high-potential events, critical controls, occupational health, regulatory matters, and contractor performance.
* Lead strategic engagement with Ontario regulators, emergency services, joint health and safety committees, workforce representatives, and independent assurance providers.
* Provide health and safety leadership through major transitions including mobilization, excavation, structural completion, fit-out, permanent power, dynamic testing, trial operations, and handover.
* Sponsor serious incident investigations and learning reviews, ensuring systemic causes are addressed and improvements are verified across the program.
* Provide independent, evidence-based advice where schedule, cost, production, or stakeholder pressure conflicts with safe delivery.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, hazards, occupational illnesses, and regulatory interactions are reported and governed transparently.
* Maintain auditable records and ensure executive decisions, acceptance of risk, exemptions, and corrective actions are documented appropriately.
* Challenge normalization of deviance, weak supervision, under-reporting, recurring deficiencies, and superficial close-out.
* Escalate significant legal, safety, reputational, or operational risks promptly with clear options and recommendations.
* Protect workers’ rights and confidentiality while meeting legal, contractual, and governance obligations.
* Lead, structure, and develop the program health and safety function, including senior managers, managers, advisers, inspectors, occupational health resources, and specialist support.
* Establish clear functional accountabilities, competency requirements, succession plans, resource forecasts, and performance expectations.
* Coach program executives, project directors, construction leaders, and contractor leadership to integrate risk control into business and delivery decisions.
* Promote worker engagement, learning teams, joint inspections, critical-control verification, and effective joint health and safety committees.

**You’ll Need To Have:**

* Proven Director-level or head-of-function health and safety leadership experience on major subway, metro, railway, underground, or similarly complex infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated accountability for multiple contractors, projects, stations, or work packages within a major program environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of underground station construction, deep excavations, shafts, temporary works, lifting, confined spaces, utilities, MEP, rail systems, and commissioning interfaces.
* Thorough knowledge of Ontario occupational health and safety requirements, constructor duties, employer responsibilities, worker rights, and joint health and safety committees.
* Experience designing and governing health and safety management systems, critical-risk frameworks, assurance programs, and executive performance reporting.
* Experience leading serious incident investigations and organizational learning across major projects.
* Ability to influence program executives, clients, contractors, designers, regulators, and workforce representatives.
* Strong executive communication, governance, negotiation, decision-making, coaching, and crisis-management capability.
* A record of improving culture, leading indicators, critical-control effectiveness, contractor accountability, and occupational health outcomes.
* A degree or recognized qualification in occupational health and safety, engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.
* A Canadian Registered Safety Professional designation, Canadian Health and Safety Consultant designation, National Construction Safety Officer designation, or equivalent professional credential is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience, including substantial Director-level or head-of-function responsibility on major infrastructure programs.
* Experience with ISO 45001-aligned management systems, risk-based assurance, human factors, organizational learning, and critical-control management.
* Formal training in incident investigation, auditing, emergency management, occupational hygiene, or behavioural and human factors approaches is advantageous.
* Experience in operational rail environments, underground works, brownfield interfaces, or transit commissioning is strongly preferred.
* A visible, credible, authoritative, and solutions-focused executive leadership style with the confidence to challenge decisions at any level.
* Eligibility to work in Canada and willingness to work across project offices, stations, shafts, tunnels, compounds, and operational environments in the Greater Toronto Area.

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel:** We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

**Note:** The estimated salary for this position is 130,000 - 180,000 CAD. Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills and qualifications.

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organization.

We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role.

Title: Head of Sales, North America — Agentis Asset Management Services
Description:
**Our Firm**

Asset Management Services (“AMS”) is the asset management practice of Agentis Capital Advisors, a global infrastructure advisory and investment platform. AMS manages more than 120 infrastructure assets representing over $35bn in enterprise value across renewables, public-private partnerships, digital and social infrastructure. We support our clients over the life of their assets through four service pillars:

* Financial Model Management – We build, standardize, enhance and maintain the financial models behind our clients’ funds and portfolio companies
* Financial Services Management – We run the accounting, budgeting, lender compliance and financial reporting for project companies
* Operations Management – We oversee the day-to-day management of assets, including contract administration, performance monitoring, and board and stakeholder support

AMS gives private markets and infrastructure investors one consistent, auditable and trusted view of their portfolios, delivered as a managed service. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, developers and project companies. Our guiding principles of excellence, client success, commitment, people and entrepreneurship set us apart.

**The Opportunity**

Private-markets managers and large asset owners run their portfolios on hundreds of inconsistent models, built by different advisors in different formats. Valuation, investor reporting and portfolio oversight are slow, manual and hard to audit. AMS solves this. We take over a client’s portfolio models, rebuild them to one standard on our technology-enabled platform, and deliver a live, fund-level view of the whole portfolio. We maintain and enhance it with our specialists on an ongoing basis.

We are looking for a Head of Sales, North America to take this service to market and expand our client base. This is a hands-on, player-coach role, reporting to the Agentis Capital Managing Partners.

This role suits a commercially driven seller who has sold value-added services into funds (e.g., fund administration, back-office, data, valuation or portfolio-monitoring software and services), selling to CEOs, heads of asset management, CFOs, COOs and finance teams of private-markets managers. You want to own a territory and build a business, not inherit a book.

**Our Differentiators**

* The first dedicated sales leader for a new AMS service line, shaping how it goes to market from day one

* Ability to build on Agentis’s long-standing relationships with infrastructure funds, pension funds and asset owners across North America
* A competitive base plus uncapped commission tied to the recurring revenue you bring in

* An entrepreneurial culture with a flat structure and direct access to Partners and senior leadership, where good ideas are acted on quickly

**Build and Run the North American Pipeline**

* Use Agentis’s existing relationships, working with Partners to convert warm introductions into qualified opportunities
* Keep the CRM accurate as the system of record for contacts, meetings, pipeline stage, forecast and next steps

**Win and Close Mandates**

* Lead the full sales cycle, from discovery and demonstrations to pilots, proposals, pricing, negotiation and signed multi-year mandates

* Address data-security, information-handling and technology questions with the AMS delivery team, including due-diligence questionnaires

**Shape the Go-to-Market**

Title: Head of Pre-Sales
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182470

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  
  
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Head of Pre-Sales at Al-Futtaim Technologies is responsible for leading the regional Pre-Sales function across the UAE, KSA, and Qatar. This position ensures the governance, quality, and final sign-off of technical solutions, estimates, cost sheets, and bid submissions. The role is pivotal in qualifying opportunities, ensuring technical compliance, deliverability, cost competitiveness, and successful handover to delivery teams. The Head of Pre-Sales also manages the pre-sales operating model, engagement frameworks, and feedback loops to improve bid speed, solution differentiation, and customer conversion rates while safeguarding gross margin.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Leadership, Strategy and Capacity**

  
  

* Lead the regional Pre-Sales function and establish a high-performance, customer-centric and control-focused culture with clear LOB ownership, workload allocation, succession and capability plans.
* Develop and execute the Product and Services Strategy across supported domains, aligned with market priorities, partnership strengths, recurring-revenue opportunities and AFT delivery capability.
* Maintain a capacity plan by geography and LOB; prioritize strategic bids; identify skill gaps; and recommend hiring, cross-utilization, automation or approved external support.
* Ensure senior pre-sales governance remains independent enough to challenge scope, pricing, and risk while collaborating closely with Sales.
  

  

#### **Opportunity Qualification and Bid Governance**

  
  

* Implement a documented bid/no-bid and Go/No-Go process covering strategic fit, probability, client budget, technical feasibility, compliance, delivery capacity, cash/credit exposure, contract risk, vendor readiness, and expected margin.
* Assign a bid owner, independent reviewer, RACI, timeline, and dependency plan at kickoff; front-load site surveys, portal access, RFIs, vendor engagement, and approvals.
* Chair deal-desk reviews for major or high-risk opportunities and obtain all required DOA approvals before submission.
* Maintain clear decision records for proceed, re-scope, partner, no-bid, and management-approved strategic-margin exceptions.
  

  

#### **Solution Architecture, Design Assurance, and Consultant Management**

  
  

* Govern the design basis and solution architecture, including integrations, capacity, redundancy, lifecycle, supportability, cybersecurity, authority requirements and delivery feasibility.
* Ensure a requirements traceability and compliance matrix is completed for every material bid, with each requirement classified as compliant, qualified, deviated, excluded, or subject to clarification.
* Lead consultant/client technical strategy: workshops, RFIs, technical clarifications, alternative approvals, material-submittal dependencies, brand/specification changes, and documented acceptance of deviations.
  

  

#### **Cost Estimation and Estimate Completeness**

  
  

* Establish and enforce an Estimate Completeness Standard for project, service and AMC proposals. No estimate is complete until the scope, quantities, interfaces, duration, resources, risks and commercial inputs have been independently checked.
* Ensure cost sheets capture, where applicable: Principal and local materials; freight, customs, duty, FX and escalation; accessories, consumables, back boxes and mock-ups; BIM/CAD/design.
* Validate manpower using the programme, work breakdown, geography, site conditions and Finance/HR-approved fully loaded rates. Obtain Delivery/PMO or Service Delivery validation before finalization.
* Approve the estimate only when unresolved items are quantified, allocated to a named owner and covered through contingency, qualification, variation entitlement or management-approved risk acceptance.
  

  

#### **Commercial Competitiveness and Vendor/OEM Management**

  
  

* Create a competitive solution and pricing strategy from the first submission, normally including a fully compliant base option and an AFT-designed value-engineered alternative where the tender permits.
* Build and manage principal, OEM, distributor and specialist-partner relationships; secure registrations, certifications, rebates, project discounts, price validity, lead-time commitments, and technical support early in the cycle.
  

  

#### **Proposal Quality and Submission Control**

  
  

* Ensure proposals are complete, accurate, persuasive and aligned with RFP format, technical and commercial separation, required certificates, datasheets, drawings, compliance matrices and submission instructions.
* Enforce a two-level review for major bids: preparer/LOB review followed by independent cross-check and Head of Pre-Sales sign-off.
* Ensure timely submission of all tenders across UAE, KSA and Qatar, with documented exceptions and recovery actions.
  

  

#### **Service, AMC and Casual-Job Costing**

  
  

* Ensure Pre-Sales is the single point of accountability for service-proposal solution design, BOQ, vendor quotations and costing completeness before customer submission.
* Use Finance-approved loaded man-hour rates and validate service frequency, response/resolution commitments, standby/on-call requirements, vehicles, tools, spares, subcontract support, escalation, warranty overlap and contract duration.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Technical proficiency in solution architecture across ICT, ELV, and integrated digital systems.
* Advanced estimate review and cost modeling capabilities including Excel, CRM, and analytics platforms.
* Strategic leadership and decision-making skills with a focus on competitiveness and risk management.
* Strong negotiation, executive presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Controls/Automation or a relevant discipline.
* MBA, Master's degree, chartered/professional engineering credential or recognized commercial/estimating qualification is preferred.
* 12-15 years of progressive experience in ICT, ELV/SSLV, BMS, AV, digital or systems-integration pre-sales, including significant regional leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-country tendering and major, multi-system bids in UAE and/or KSA; experience in Qatar is advantageous.
  

  

About Al-Futtaim Real Estate

With a legacy of more than six decades in real estate and asset management, Al-Futtaim Real Estate – part of Al-Futtaim – creates real impact on the communities it serves through long-term investment and growth. As one of the region’s leading private developers, the company plans, creates and manages developments across the MENA region.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate has a diversified, multi-billion-dollar portfolio across the real estate value chain and asset types such as residential, commercial, malls and industries including hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure and education. Flagship mixed-use urban communities include Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate is also responsible for Al-Futtaim Contracting, a fully integrated, end-to-end specialist division operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Egypt. The business has delivered industry-leading construction, engineering, technology and FM solutions for more than 50 years.

**Customer Focus**

Chorus serves a mix of public and private healthcare and human services organizations, including:

* State and County Departments of Mental Health
* Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHCs)
* Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs)
* Community mental health providers and related agencies

  

The Head of Sales will be comfortable selling into complex healthcare environments with long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and existing technology ecosystems.

**Revenue & Sales Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and scale a national team of Account Executives

**Go-To-Market & Sales Execution**

* Guide the team toward opportunities that balance customer needs with delivery, implementation, and long-term scalability
* Help position Chorus effectively within customers' existing healthcare technology ecosystems
* Ensure deals are well-framed, well-scoped, and positioned for long-term success

  

**Executive Selling & Market Presence**

* Leverage an existing network of healthcare, behavioral health, and public-sector relationships
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, system leaders, and decision-makers
* Represent Chorus at industry events, conferences, and executive forums
* Act as a senior closer and ambassador for Chorus's value proposition in the market

  

**Marketing & Growth Leadership**

* Partner closely with the SVP of Growth to ensure strong coordination between new-logo sales and account expansion
* Depending on experience, directly oversee Marketing and help grow a small, evolving team
* Strengthen lead generation, demand creation, and sales–marketing alignment
* Ensure marketing efforts are tightly connected to sales priorities and conversion goals

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Work closely with Product, Delivery, and Customer Success to align sales strategy with product capabilities

* Balance growth ambition with operational discipline and long-term customer success

### **Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive revenue or sales leadership experience in healthcare technology, health IT, or SaaS
* Proven success leading sales teams through periods of growth and change, including building structure while actively selling
* Experience selling into both public and private healthcare organizations
* Track record of driving licensing-based or recurring revenue growth

* Experience positioning solutions alongside EHRs and other healthcare systems

Title: Business Growth/Sales Manager
Description:
### **About Jeeny**

Jeeny is a mobile application that eases daily commuting and transportation. Founded in 2012, Jeeny is one of the region’s leading ride-hailing platforms operating across the Middle East, delivering reliable, affordable, and innovative mobility solutions. At Jeeny, we foster a collaborative and fast-paced environment where employees are empowered to make an impact and grow professionally.

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a high-performing Business Growth/Sales Manager to join our Jeeny for Business (J4B) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Reporting directly to the Director of Commercial, you will drive the strategic expansion, commercial growth, and operational execution of our end-to-end B2B corporate mobility solutions across the Kingdom.

In this role, you will build long-term client/enterprise partnerships, identify untapped market opportunities, and launch specialised corporate mobility products with smart go-to-market strategies, positioning J4B as the primary transport platform for companies of all sizes.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* B2B Pipeline & Enterprise Acquisition:
* + Build, manage, and execute a strong commercial pipeline across KSA, targeting client segments ranging from high-growth SMEs to multinational Regional Headquarters (RHQs), government bodies, and giga-project contractors.
  + Lead end-to-end sales cycles from initial outreach and high-level client presentations to negotiating and closing long-term corporate mobility agreements.
* Tenders & RFPs:
* + Lead the preparation, commercial structuring, and submission of formal RFPs (Requests for Proposals) and government tenders across public sector entities and giga-project developers.
* Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy & Product Rollout:
* + Develop localized GTM strategies to launch and scale new J4B products, customised corporate packages, and specialised service tiers (including employee commuting, event logistics, and executive chauffeur solutions).
  + Identify untapped market gaps in Saudi Arabia’s corporate transport sector and translate client feedback into actionable product/tech road-map.
* Account Management & Volume Growth:
* + Partner closely with client HR, Finance, and Corporate Travel Managers to ensure smooth on-boarding onto the J4B portal.
  + Monitor account health, drive platform adoption across client employees, and upsell new transport solutions to maximise monthly ride volume and lifetime value (LTV).
* Pricing Framework:
* + Structure competitive corporate rate cards, volume discounts, and customised credit terms while safeguarding healthy unit economics.
* Cross-Functional & Operational Alignment:
* + Collaborate directly with BizOps Manager(s) to ensure corporate SLA compliance, driver fulfilment rates, and quality standards across corporate executive rides.
  + Work alongside Finance teams to ensure timely corporate invoicing, payment collections, account reconciliation, and credit limit management across all J4B accounts.
  + Work alongside Product/Tech teams to translate client feedback and market gaps into scalable portal features, enhanced reporting tools, and seamless enterprise tech integrations.
* Reporting & Insights:
* + Track and report on core performance metrics, including Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), corporate active users, and pipeline health.
  + Deliver weekly commercial updates, revenue forecasts, and strategic market insights.

  
**Requirements**  

* At least 5 years of proven experience of fast-paced B2B sales or business development experience in KSA, with a strong track record of selling services to SMEs, enterprises, and public sector clients.
* A proven ability to source, negotiate, and successfully close high-value corporate deals while consistently exceeding ambitious revenue targets.
* Fluent in both Arabic and English and excel at building strong, long-lasting relationships with client decision-makers and internal stakeholders.
* Comfortably partners across Operations, Finance, and Product/Tech teams to ensure seamless client onboarding, contract compliance, and service delivery.
* Demonstrates high initiative, proactively solve operational and commercial challenges, and take complete ownership of your work and results.

Preferred

* An existing network among corporate travel, admin, and procurement decision-makers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
* Experience responding to government tenders or giga-project procurement processes.
* In compliance with local labor regulations and Saudization requirements, this role is reserved exclusively for Saudi Nationals.

  
**Benefits**

### **Why Join Jeeny?**

* Be part of one of the leading mobility platforms in the region.
* Work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Opportunity to lead impactful finance initiatives and process improvements.
* Career growth and professional development opportunities.

Title: Head of Sales
Description:
**About Us**

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

**The Opportunity**

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead and develop the sales team**

* Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
* Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
* Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
* Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

**Own pipeline, forecast and results**

* Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
* Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
* Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
* Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

**Build the sales engine**

* Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
* Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
* Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
* Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
* Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

**Partner across the business**

* Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
* Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
* Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
* Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
* Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
* A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
* Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
* Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
* A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
* Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
* The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope at the right moment.** You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
* **Expertise that scales.** Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
* **Own the outcomes.** We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
* **Do the right thing.** We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.

* **A remote team that stays connected.** We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
* **Momentum you can sell.** A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.

* **Variable compensation:** On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
* **Benefits:** Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment
