Title: Claims Officer
Description:
**\*\*\*PREFERENCE WILL BE GIVEN TO QATARI CANDIDATES\*\*\***
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Reporting structure**
-----------------------

**Reports to:** Head of Chartering

**Direct Reportees:** None

**Location:** Doha

**Job Summary and Purpose**
---------------------------

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels in line with charter party warranties and generate a monthly summary report highlighting any areas of over/underperformance (actual and potential). Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.
* Recommend actions to resolve performance issues and continuously work towards the performance and efficiency of the fleet of ships.
* Monitor, track, and execute relevant cost reimbursement claims to charterers while liaising with the relevant internal stakeholders, i.e. Insurance, Finance, Fleet, etc.
* Provide relevant documents and information to successfully address any audit (internal and/or external) requirements.
* Support chartering & post fixture activities by ensuring compliance with charter party terms.
* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

**Key Accountabilities 2**
--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.
* Support the team in coordinating the periodical meetings with vessels’ technical manager to address any technical/operational issues which could have a commercial impact as well as address any customers’ concerns.
* Support the team in coordinating timely between Charterers and vessels’ technical manager to conduct any Owners’ related matters (e.g., SIRE, Crew change, spares delivery, lube oil supply) with minimum deviation and minimum (target zero) off hire & claim avoidance.

**Generic Accountabilities**
----------------------------

**Quality, Health, Safety, & Environment (QHSE):**

* Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions, and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
* Track EUETS reports, procure EUAs and seek re-imbursement from charterers.
* Track Fuel EU compliance balance and other environmental regulations related to commercial settlement with charterers.

**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures:**

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
* Recommend updates for the division’s relevant P&Ps for claims, as deemed appropriate to cope with evolving business needs.

**Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Business/Economics/Technical of Marine Engineering or any other relevant field.
* Diploma in ship management and operations (ICS preferred).
* Diploma in ship chartering (ICS preferred).

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience as a charterer, shipping and commercial operator in a ship-owning company, chartering desk, trading desk, International Oil & Gas Company, or brokerage house.
* Ideally most recent position should involve commercial and post-fixture operations of vessels preferably LNGCs, VLGCs or tankers.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* Experience in contracts and claims negotiation will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of Shipping Commercial management – Chartering and Post-fixture Operations.
* Good record of leading and managing claims negotiations and minimizing commercial exposure.

Title: H&S and Facilities Coordinator
Description:
Job Posting Date: 19 Nov 2026

Location:
Doha, QA

Job ID: 10739

School: Compass International School Doha

Company: Nord Anglia Education

**Location:** Compass International School, Doha, Qatar
  
**Reports to:** Operations Manager

**Job Purpose**

  

The H&S & Facilities Coordinator is responsible for the school’s health and safety arrangements, operation and maintenance of its buildings, grounds and infrastructure. The role ensures a safe, secure, compliant and well-maintained environment for students, staff, visitors and contractors. It supports the implementation of Nord Anglia Education (NAE) health and safety policies, school procedures and Qatar regulatory requirements, while promoting a proactive and positive safety culture.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Health & Safety**

* Manage and support the school’s health and safety management system, ensuring policies and procedures are understood and applied.
* Give practical health and safety advice to school leadership, operations, facilities, teaching and support staff.
* Coordinate and maintain risk assessments for activities, facilities, educational visits, events, contractors and higher-risk areas, and monitor control measures.
* Carry out regular site inspections (classrooms, laboratories, sports areas, playgrounds, facilities and transport areas), record findings and follow up actions.
* Ensure accidents, incidents, near misses and hazards are reported and investigated; identify root causes and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Use the school’s health and safety management system to track incidents, inspections, audits, risk assessments and outstanding actions.
* Support emergency preparedness, including fire evacuation, lockdown and medical emergency procedures, and coordinate drills and follow-up.
* Deliver or coordinate inductions, refresher training and awareness sessions, and maintain training records.
* Support internal and external audits, inspections and reviews.
  

**Facilities & Maintenance**

* Manage the day-to-day operation of the school estate, keeping facilities safe, functional and fit for purpose.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, testing and certification, and maintain compliance records.
* Manage contractors and service providers, ensuring work is safe, efficient and to the required quality standard, including reviewing documentation, inductions and monitoring on site.
* Maintain asset registers, equipment records and maintenance histories to support lifecycle planning.
* Provide facilities support for school events, examinations and emergency situations.
  

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare regular health and safety and facilities reports for the Operations Manager, Principal and Regional Health & Safety Manager.
* Identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities to improve safety, maintenance and service delivery, and support school health and safety improvement plans.
  

**Key Relationships**

  

**Internal:** Principal and Senior Leadership Team; Operations Manager; Finance Team; Facilities and Maintenance Team; School Nurse / Medical Team; Teaching and Support Staff; Heads of Department; Security, Transport and Catering Teams

  

**Regional:** Regional Health & Safety Manager; Regional Operations Director

  

**External:** Contractors and service providers; parents and visitors where required; local authorities and regulatory bodies where required

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

  

**Essential**

* Relevant qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, such as the NEBOSH International General Certificate or equivalent, or equivalent experience.
* Degree, diploma or equivalent in Facilities Management, Engineering, Construction or a related discipline.
* Experience in a health and safety role, preferably within a school, education, facilities, hospitality, healthcare or similar operational environment.
* Experience managing facilities operations, maintenance programmes and contractors in a complex operational environment.
* Good understanding of risk assessment, inspections, incident investigation and corrective action management.
* Good understanding of building maintenance, statutory compliance and facilities management.
* Strong communication and organisational skills, and the ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders in a school environment.
* Good IT skills and the ability to maintain accurate records.
  

**Desirable**

* IOSH Managing Safely.
* First Aid or Fire Safety training.
* Certified Facility Manager (CFM), FMP or equivalent.
* Project management qualification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Experience using health and safety management systems.
* Experience supporting audits, emergency drills and contractor safety.
* Experience in an education environment and/or in Qatar or the wider GCC.
  

**Personal Attributes**

  

The successful candidate will be proactive, organised, practical and solutions-focused. They will manage competing priorities, take ownership and build positive relationships with staff, students, contractors and leadership teams. They will stay calm under pressure and show attention to detail, sound judgement and integrity, with a commitment to a safe, healthy, compliant and well-presented school.

  

**Safeguarding**

  

Compass International School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The successful candidate must comply with all safeguarding, child protection and safer recruitment requirements, including relevant background checks.

Description:

Together, we are delivering Accelerator, a major program of Pearson LIFT (Long-term Investment in Facilities and Terminals), Toronto Pearson's infrastructure development plan. This multi-year program is designed to address immediate passenger growth demands while preparing Canada’s largest airport for the future of air travel—including critical upgrades to airfield and infrastructure, greenhouse gas reduction initiatives, modernization of Terminals 1 and 3, and the creation of a world-class passenger experience.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Environmental Inspector is responsible for ensuring that all construction activities within the PACT program comply with applicable environmental regulations, project-specific environmental management plans, and industry best practices. This role plays a critical part in supporting sustainable construction practices while minimizing environmental impacts across project sites.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with federal, provincial, and municipal environmental regulations, as well as project permits and approvals.
* Monitor construction activities for adherence to Environmental Management Plans (EMPs), Erosion and Sediment Control (ESC) measures, and Spill Prevention Plans.
* Identify and document environmental risks, non-compliance issues, and potential impacts to soil, air, water, and wildlife.
* Prepare detailed inspection reports, including observations, deficiencies, corrective actions, and photographic records.
* Maintain accurate environmental logs, monitoring data, and regulatory documentation for audits and reporting requirements.
* Support internal and external environmental audits and regulatory inspections.
* Respond to environmental incidents (e.g., spills, unauthorized discharges, wildlife disturbances) and ensure proper containment, reporting, and remediation actions are implemented.
* Provide recommendations for corrective actions and follow-up to ensure resolution.
* Work closely with construction managers, subcontractors, engineers, and environmental consultants to promote compliance and environmental awareness.
* Communicate environmental requirements and site expectations to field teams and subcontractors.
* Liaise with regulatory agencies as required.
* Promote sustainable construction practices, waste reduction, and pollution prevention initiatives.
* Monitor waste management processes, including proper handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous materials.
* Support with environmental training and toolbox talks for site personnel.
* Support with other duties as needed.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

Your work schedule will be during site hours. Flexibility to work nights and weekends, as required by the construction schedule, is expected. Any schedule changes or on-call requirements will be managed in accordance with applicable employment standards legislation. It is mandatory for all employees to complete a Criminal Background check and successfully attain a Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) upon joining the company.

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Diploma or degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or related discipline.
* Certified Environmental Professional (CEP) or similar designation is considered an asset.
* Erosion & Sediment Control certification is considered an asset.
* 3-5+ years of environmental inspection experience, preferably in construction, infrastructure, or large-scale development projects.
* Strong knowledge of Ontario environmental regulations and guidelines (e.g., MECP standards, ECA requirements).
* Experience with carbon reporting frameworks or sustainability programs is an asset.
* Experience with large infrastructure or transportation projects is an asset.
* Experience conducting environmental monitoring, inspections, and audits.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, and manage documentation.
* Proactive problem‑solver with strong organizational skills.

  

*PACT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free candidate experience and work environment. If you require accommodation to apply or if selected to participate in an assessment process, please advise Human Resources.*

Title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting
Description:
### **Welcome to PxGeo**

PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.

### **What's the role?**

Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.

This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:  
  
**Commercial Contracting**

* Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
* + offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
  + specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
  + agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
  + software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
  + purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
  + other operational and project-related arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
* Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
* Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
* Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
* + liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
  + warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
  + intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
  + delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
  + suspension and termination; force majeure;
  + regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
* Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
* Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**Business and Project Support**

* Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
* Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
* Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
* Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
* Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
* Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.

**Contracting Standards and Legal Processes**

* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
* Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
* Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
* Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
* Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
* Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.
* Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and translate them into workable contractual arrangements.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from matters that can be managed operationally.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex and time-sensitive matters with limited supervision.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
* + energy or oil and gas; offshore services; seismic or geophysical services; marine or shipping; vessel chartering; procurement and Supply Chain contracting; or international project-based operations.
* Previous in-house experience within an international, operational or project-based organisation would be a strong advantage.

Title: Safety Engineer
Description:
Core Role and Responsibilities:

* Execute the Project HSE Plan, method statements, risk assessments (JSA/HAZID), and

COSHH controls; maintain evidence of competence and ensure resources for HSE are

adequate and sustained throughout the works

* Maintain all HSE documentation, including audit and inspection reports, and ensure

compliance with all KAHRAMAA and national HSE requirements.

* Participate in toolbox talks, safety briefings ,attend meetings, training sessions, and

workshops as required by KAHRAMAA.

* Enforce KAHRAMAA HSE rules at sites; support the HSE Manager/Coordinator in

developing the training matrix, audit/inspection plans, and coordination with KAHRAMAA on

HSE matters.

* Conduct site HSE inductions; lead toolbox talks; deliver/arrange topic-specific training

(Emergency Response & Preparedness, HAZMAT, Confined Space, Working at Height,

Lockout/Tagout, Electrical Safety, Lifting & Rigging, Power Tool Safety, Excavation Safety,

PPE, Waste Management, Incident Reporting & Investigation, Root Cause Analysis)

* Ensure appropriate PPE is issued, conforms to KAHRAMAA requirements, and is

inspected/maintained regularly (helmets, shoes, goggles/face shields, dust goggles, gloves,

harnesses/lifelines.)

* Maintain site housekeeping and safe storage/handling of materials, including

flammable/hazardous substances; implement controls for hot-work and welding areas with

suitable firefighting equipment.

* Keep portable firefighting equipment available on site from commencement to takeover;

ensure maintenance and mandatory weekly checks; recharge after use and manage stocks

of fresh charges; control open flames and flammable materials per KAHRAMAA instructions.

* Immediately notify KAHRAMAA of accidents/near misses; secure the site/witnesses; submit

Initial Incident Report and final investigation report as per KAHRAMAA guidelines.

Keep accident logs, patient/illness records, and periodic medical exam reporting as required

by national regulations referenced by KAHRAMAA.

* Execute planned audits/inspections; issue NCRs; drive corrective/preventive actions;

escalate unresolved hazards; exercise stop-work authority where necessary; track closure

and communicate changes to personnel

* Oversee electrical safety controls during installation, replacement, testing, commissioning,

and maintenance of LV and HV electricity meters and communication modules, including

working-at-height, energized work controls, lockout/tagout, and safe cabling/antenna

installation in poor-signal areas (subject to KAHRAMAA approval)

* Ensure use of dedicated communication signal strength analyzers (no mobile apps

permitted) when validating AMI communications; coordinate safe handling/transport/storage

of assets with KAHRAMAA access for inspection.

* Maintain daily/weekly/monthly safety reports, inspection logs, incident registers, training

records, and PPE registers; support project progress reporting cadence and WBS execution

phases (Engineering/Procurement/Execution/Close-out) with HSE inputs.

* Provide hard/soft copies of HSE documentation for audits and at KAHRAMAA’s request.

* Coordinate with KAHRAMAA HSE Department, line departments, customers, contractors,

and telecom providers for shutdowns, emergency works, and multi-site mobilization;

participate in emergency drills and ensure readiness of response teams.

* Maintain availability across three shifts in a 24×7 environment; travel between venues/depots

during and outside office hours for inspections, incident response, and verification of

corrective actions (as operationally required).

***Qualification & experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in Fire & Safety, Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or

related discipline);

* KAHRAMAA-approved First Aid and Basic Fire Fighting certificates required; ISO

45001/14001 Lead Auditor, Risk Management (QRA/JSA/HAZID) training preferred.

* Demonstrated experience in Construction/Industrial Safety within utility/infrastructure

projects; ability to coordinate and manage HSE issues, conduct audits/incident

investigations, and apply applicable national/international HSE laws.

* Hands-on experience supporting metering roll-outs (including LV/HV Electricity meters) and

AMI field operations with safe methods of work and compliance to KAHRAMAA procedure.

Pay: QAR8,000.00 - QAR11,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:
Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

We are seeking a seasoned and results-driven
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to provide strategic and executive leadership across our data center operations, with enterprise-wide accountability for operational excellence, mission-critical infrastructure availability, reliability, resilience, scalability, customer commitments, and service delivery.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO will play a pivotal role in translating Syntys’ ambitious growth strategy into scalable operational capabilities, building a high-performing organization, and ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of our data center platform.

The role encompasses executive leadership and oversight of Data Center Operations, Critical Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) Infrastructure, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability, ensuring integrated governance, operational resilience, and consistent performance across all markets.

The COO will be instrumental in enabling business growth and delivering world-class operational standards to meet the demanding requirements of hyperscale cloud providers, AI infrastructure customers, GPU-intensive computing environments, and wholesale colocation clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Enterprise Operations & Strategic Leadership:**
  Develop and execute the enterprise-wide operations strategy, establishing scalable, standardized, and performance-driven operating models across all markets and facilities.
* **Mission-Critical Infrastructure & Engineering Operations:**
  Oversee mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, power, fire protection, and facilities infrastructure, ensuring availability, reliability, uptime, and maintenance excellence. Ensure commissioning acceptance, integrated systems testing, and seamless transition from construction and project delivery into live operations.
* **Hyperscale & AI Infrastructure:**
  Drive operational readiness for hyperscale cloud, AI training, AI inference, and high-performance computing environments, including high-density power requirements, GPU infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling technologies, large-scale customer deployments, and phased capacity activation.
* **Executive Oversight of Operational Functions:**
  Provide executive oversight across headquarters and market operations, Critical Facilities Operations (Mechanical & Electrical), Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management (FM), Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability.
* **Operational Governance, Risk & Compliance:**
  Establish operational governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and controls across all facilities. Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency response, crisis management, operational audits, risk assessments, regulatory compliance, Operational Technology (OT) Security, cybersecurity resilience, and third-party operator and contractor performance. Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards and data center frameworks, including Uptime Institute Tier standards and relevant ISO standards.
* **Customer Experience & Strategic Account Management:**
  Ensure delivery against contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific requirements. Act as the senior executive escalation point for major operational incidents and customer concerns. Lead operational business reviews and support commercial growth through operational assurance and executive-level customer engagement.
* **Financial Performance, Asset Management & Sustainability:**
  Own operational expenditure (OPEX) performance and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning and investment prioritization. Drive cost optimization, asset lifecycle management, operational productivity, procurement effectiveness, vendor performance, budgeting, and financial forecasting. Lead energy efficiency, carbon reduction, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE).
* **Leadership, Organization & Talent Development:**
  Build and lead high-performing operations teams, establish clear organizational structures and leadership accountability, and drive succession planning, talent development, retention, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, operational discipline, safety, customer focus, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline. A Master's degree or relevant professional certifications are advantageous.
* **Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience**
  , including significant senior leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or critical facilities environments.
* Proven track record of leading
  **large-scale, multi-site or geographically distributed data center operations**
  , preferably at COO, SVP Operations, or equivalent senior leadership level.
* Solid experience managing
  **hyperscaler, cloud service provider, and strategic customer relationships**
  , with a strong understanding of contractual commitments, SLAs, and service delivery expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in
  **mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure**
  , including power systems, cooling technologies, maintenance strategies, operational reliability, and resilience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing key operational functions, including
  **Data Center Operations, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, IT, and Cybersecurity**
  , with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage operational interdependencies.
* Proven ability to manage
  **operational risks, critical incidents, business continuity, and crisis situations**
  , demonstrating sound judgment, accountability, and effective decision-making under pressure.
* Strong
  **commercial and financial acumen**
  , including operational budgeting, cost optimization, asset management, and vendor performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to
  **build and develop high-performing teams, strengthen operational governance, and scale operations**
  in a growing, multi-market business environment.
* Exposure to
  **AI infrastructure, high-density computing, GPU environments, and advanced cooling technologies**
  is highly desirable.

The GTS Strategy and Insights team helps shape where GTS goes next—and how we tell that story. The AVP - GTS Strategy and Insights will lead a team responsible for executive deliverables, strategic planning, enterprise and industry research, executive communications, and performance reporting against GTS priorities. **Job Description**
-------------------

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and communication—understanding complex technology and business issues, identifying what matters, and translating that thinking into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives.

* Lead all strategy-related deliverables required through enterprise processes or as directed by ESVP Global Technology and Solutions, ensuring each is grounded in evidence, aligned to GTS priorities, and positioned to support executive decisions.

* Responsible for leading the development and refresh of GTS’ short, medium, and long-term strategy, and priorities, translating strategic direction into actionable focus areas, investment ideas, and measurable outcomes.
* Develop insights on strategic issues facing GTS, including technology modernization, software delivery, artificial intelligence adoption, workforce transformation, productivity, cyber resilience, data and cloud, cost management, and regulatory priorities.

Techify is a forward-thinking technology company helping businesses work smarter through proactive IT, cybersecurity, and AI-powered solutions.

Our mission is simple: **Leave People Feeling Smarter and Fired Up.**

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.

* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.

* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

Title: Customer Delivery Software Architect
Description:

Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is seeking a Customer Delivery Software Architect to lead the design and delivery of automation and AI-enabled solutions for a major service provider in Saudi Arabia.
  
  
You will define scalable software architectures that connect network infrastructure, operational systems, data platforms, and business workflows. Working with customer stakeholders and cross-functional Cisco teams, you will translate complex operational needs into secure, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
This is a software architecture role—not a network migration or product implementation role. Its primary focus is establishing sound architecture, engineering practices, integration patterns, and governance for network automation and intelligent operations.
  
  
Frequent onsite collaboration in Riyadh is required due to customer access controls, local testing requirements, and the need to work closely with engineering and operations teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end software architecture for network automation, orchestration, assurance, observability, and AI-enabled operational solutions.
* Translate business and operational requirements into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, integration patterns, data models, APIs, and engineering backlogs.
* Design secure, modular, scalable solutions integrating network platforms with systems such as Cisco Crosswork.
* Establish engineering standards covering source control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, release management, security, and software lifecycle governance.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design and delivery, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring implementations meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Leads and influences global, cross-functional teams—including PMs, PgMs, SDMs, CEs, TLs, and customer stakeholders—to ensure successful delivery of complex, multi-architecture solutions aligned to business outcomes
* Define practical approaches for applying AI and analytics to use cases such as anomaly detection, operational insight, decision support, and workflow automation.
* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices while mentoring engineers and strengthening software architecture capabilities across delivery teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12 or more years of relevant experience; master’s degree with 8 or more years; PhD with 5 or more years; or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade software, automation, orchestration, or systems-integration solutions.
* Strong proficiency in software architecture principles, distributed systems, API design, event-driven architectures, data modelling, and integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Python or a comparable programming language, APIs, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate network infrastructure, operational platforms, telemetry, data, and business workflows.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their practical application to automation, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering teams and communicate effectively with tech.hnical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with Cisco NSO or comparable orchestration platforms, including service modelling, lifecycle management, device integration and reusable automation components.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in telecommunications, service-provider, or other large-scale, mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of network orchestration, assurance, observability, and automation platforms, including Cisco Crosswork.
* Experience establishing engineering governance and reusable automation frameworks across multiple teams.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, streaming technologies, data platforms, and AIOps.
* Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, model lifecycle management, and security-by-design.
* Experience mentoring software engineers and helping organizations adopt modern software-engineering practices.
* Nature of work: Onsite Full time
* Hours of work: 48 hours per week
* Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, Cisco infrastructure, routing and switching, wireless LAN configuration, firewall administration, network monitoring, and information security.

The successful candidate will ensure network availability, performance, security, and operational continuity while supporting infrastructure improvements and technical operations.

* Manage daily network operations and technical activities related to IT infrastructure.
* Install, configure, operate, and maintain network switches, Cisco Wireless Controllers, and Cisco Voice Gateways.
* Configure and manage VLANs and perform necessary switch modifications.
* Manage Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols, routing, and switching.
* Monitor network connectivity, internet links, leased lines, and overall network performance.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to resolve connectivity issues.

* Familiarity with Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.

* Excellent documentation, reporting, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and under pressure.

Title: Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration
Description:
**Job Description**

  

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

**AI Disclosure:** As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
* Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
* Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
* Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
* Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
* Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
* Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
* Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
* Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
* Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Operator
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.
* Deliver professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy, ensuring the highest standards of quality and service.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.
* Ensure proper case handover between shifts, maintaining continuity of operations.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

  ###
* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Risk and Crisis Management experience.
  + Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.
  + Experience of working in a customer/client-focused role.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training) in a field related to security, risk management, international politics or international relations.
* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor in Doha, Qatar.**

A prominent member of the GSOC, the Supervisor will act as a go-to-person for the Security Operator and will report to the GSOC Manager.

The GSOC Supervisor will review and monitor the tasks of the GSOC Operator and provide necessary guidance and support, as required by the GSOC Operator. The GSOC Supervisor will facilitate the timely delivery of high-quality security risk advice, will communicate with different internal stakeholders and will incorporate feedback from QatarEnergy into the day-to-day operations of the GSOC.

The GSOC Supervisor will also support security assessments relating to new and emerging market entry, conduct baseline threat monitoring and collate security risk information. The role will contribute to functional enhancement projects, support the identification and communication of security events affecting business travellers, and provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises.

Additionally, the GSOC Supervisor will work closely with the GSOC Manager and the GSOC Operator in updating relevant operational processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

* Support operational planning and readiness through the maintenance and development of security provider networks and the preparation of Concepts of Operations.
* Participate in projects relating to functional enhancements to ensure QatarEnergy maintains best-in-class security assistance capabilities.
* Ensure client awareness of the current security environment in countries across the region of responsibility.
* Travel, as required, to countries within the region to assess the security situation, evaluate local provider capabilities and expand the existing network of security contacts to support clients and operational planning.
* Support new and emerging market entry assessments by conducting baseline threat monitoring and collating relevant security risk information.
* Identify and communicate high-impact, time-sensitive security events to business travellers and internal stakeholders.
* Provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises, escalating requests for assistance to the GSOC Manager, QatarEnergy Senior Leadership and International SOS Assistance Centre, as appropriate.
* Work closely with the GSOC Manager and GSOC Operator to review and update operational processes.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

* Oversee and validate threat monitoring conducted by Operators to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Conduct baseline and enhanced threat assessments, including for new and emerging markets.
* Collate and analyse security risk data to support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Ensure timely escalation of high-impact or time-sensitive threats to stakeholders and leadership.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Supervise the delivery of travel security advice, ensuring consistency with client requirements and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Support the identification and communication of destination-specific risks to business travellers and stakeholders.
* Review incident tracking and reporting to ensure quality, accuracy and completeness.
* Facilitate coordination with internal stakeholders and external assistance providers, where required.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

  

* Act as the primary escalation point for Operators during incidents and crises.
* Provide preliminary crisis assessments and security advice to stakeholders.
* Coordinate GSOC response activities and ensure effective information flow during incidents.
* Escalate critical situations to the GSOC Manager, senior leadership and external support entities, as required.
* Support updates and improvements to operational processes and crisis response frameworks

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse operational environments.
* Demonstrated experience in security risk monitoring, intelligence analysis and incident assessment.
* Good understanding of the geopolitical and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Ability to review, validate and enhance intelligence outputs and risk assessments produced by Operators.
* Proficiency in coordinating security assistance tasks, including travel risk management and incident response.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey security risks and advice to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to analyse multiple streams of security, threat and logistical information under time pressure and provide actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with GSOC operations, escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks.
* Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and relevant operational platforms.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 5–7 years’ experience in security risk management, intelligence analysis or GSOC operations within military, government, NGO or private sector roles.
* Experience in monitoring global threats and providing security risk assessments.
* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or equivalent professional training and experience) in security studies, risk management, international relations, political science or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in security or risk management (desirable).

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Additional language skills (Arabic, French, etc.) desirable.

Title: Project Engineer - Controls Systems
Description:

The Project Engineer - Controls will report directly to the Branch Manager and will be based in Qatar. As part of the Controls & Building Automation Systems (BAS) team, you will be responsible for the engineering, design review, project execution, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of Building Management System (BMS) and Integrated Controls projects across multiple client sites.

You will work closely with customers, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications and company standards. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop advanced technical, project management, and customer engagement skills within a dynamic environment.

### **How You Will Do It**

As a Project Engineer - Controls, you will leverage your technical expertise in BMS and Building Automation Systems to support all phases of project execution, from engineering and design review through commissioning and handover.

You will:

* Execute BMS, HVAC Controls, and Building Automation projects in accordance with project schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Review project specifications, drawings, sequences of operation, and control schematics to ensure compliance with client and consultant requirements.
* Prepare engineering submittals, technical documentation, method statements, and project reports.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to facilitate smooth project execution and timely issue resolution.
* Configure, program, and commission BMS controllers, supervisory systems, field devices, and network integrations.
* Perform functional testing, point-to-point verification, system integration, and site acceptance testing.
* Provide technical support during installation, startup, testing, and commissioning activities.

* Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure adherence to project schedules and delivery milestones.
* Assist in project planning, resource allocation, procurement coordination, and material management activities.

* Prepare progress reports and maintain effective communication with all project stakeholders.

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Engineering.
* Minimum 5-6 years of experience in the design, engineering, execution, or commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), or Controls projects.
* Proven experience in HVAC controls, chiller plant controls, energy management systems, and building automation applications.
* Strong understanding of control system architectures, field devices, communication protocols, and system integrations including BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and TCP/IP networking.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, specifications, and technical submittals.
* Experience in system programming, controller configuration, graphics development, and commissioning activities.

* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

**Job Title:** Network Operations Center Supervisor I

**Department:** Network Operation Center

**About NoaNet**

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at https://noanet.net.

**Career Overview**

Support network operations center analysts in a leadership role by leading, training, and coaching a team of network analysts to provide superior customer support relating to monitoring, troubleshooting and repairing NoaNet’s and our NCS members networks consisting of multiple systems including PON, carrier Ethernet, and MPLS. Provide technical support to clients via telephone, remote access, and on-site service; provide circuit design support by interfacing with engineering, provisioning, and customers; provide technical expertise and training to network operations analyst for troubleshooting and maintenance of the network and associated equipment, interface with installers to test and turn up new circuit orders; and other duties as assigned. Provide field support to install, maintain and troubleshoot circuits and systems and, work closely with NoaNet’s engineering and sales teams, and provide guidance and support to contract installers.

**Education, Training, Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications**

* Understanding of IP/Ethernet routing and switching.
* Familiarity with Routing Protocols.

* Advanced knowledge of Core, Distribution, and Access layer designs and topologies.

The Department of Medicine at WCH advances the practice and science of medicine through holistic, innovative, and interprofessional approaches to complex health conditions and distinctive models of specialized ambulatory care. The Department advances care for conditions that disproportionately affect women and special populations, including through the specialized Dermatology, Menopause and After Cancer Treatment Transition Clinics.
